root.label: BBC Panorama and Times investigation into David Sullivan allegations

events.label: BBC Panorama and Times investigation into David Sullivan allegations

slots.name: accused women
slots.sentence: The recommendation from London Stadium comes after a joint investigation by BBC Panorama and The Times revealed that seven women have accused Sullivan of sexually exploitative and predatory behaviour .

slots.name: ban duration
slots.sentence: The investigation also revealed that Sullivan has been banned from contact with West Ham's women's and youth teams for three years due to safeguarding concerns.

slots.name: denial status
slots.sentence: He has previously said the allegation was false

slots.name: allegation date
slots.sentence: Sullivan was banned after a historic allegation about his conduct was raised with the Football Association in 2023.

slots.name: chairman status
slots.sentence: He stood down as joint chairman of the club shortly before the investigation was broadcast, saying he wanted to focus on fighting what he called "factually incorrect and entirely false, decades-old allegations concerning my personal life".

slots.name: shareholder status
slots.sentence: He remains the club's largest shareholder.
